title: New-Wearer Fitting Allowance on Vision Plans Contact-Lens Orders
content:
**Provider manual excerpt — new contact-lens wearers (Vision Plans)**

A new-wearer fitting allowance is added to the fitting of a contact-lens order when neither of the patient's latest fittings under the same provider agreement is recent. The fittings looked at are the latest standard contact-lens fitting and the latest specialty contact-lens fitting whose remark is paid or out-of-network reimbursement paid, each kind read on its own. The allowance applies unless one of them is dated before the fitting and less than thirty-six whole calendar months (36) before it.

**Reversals.** When the latest fitting of a kind is the only such service on its date and has been reversed, there is taken to be none of that kind and no earlier one is looked at. Of several on that date, a reversal of one leaves that date standing.

| Patient's fitting history under the same provider agreement | Channel | New-wearer allowance |
|---|---|---|
| No standard or specialty fitting less than 36 whole months before (a new wearer) | Participating independent practice | 15.00 |
| Same | Participating retail-chain location | 10.00 |
| A standard or specialty fitting dated before this one and less than 36 whole months before it (a returning wearer) | Any | None |
| Any | Out of network | None |

A month is complete on the same day number.

**Boundary (hypothetical dates).** The last paid specialty fitting under the agreement was 2 February. A fitting on 1 February three years later is 35 whole months later: a returning wearer, no allowance. A fitting on 2 February three years later is 36 whole months later: 15.00 at an independent practice or 10.00 at a retail chain.
